primary_result: The frozen no-op/positive-full/negative-full bank passes the preregistered development feasibility contract. Worse-operator three-action oracle gain LCB95 is +0.142598 dB, three-over-nine oracle retention LCB95 is 0.995328, and repairable-fraction LCB95 is 0.808594. Risk labels are sufficient at the clean-image grouped unit: positive-full has 90 severe groups and negative-full 277, with minimum cross-operator severe agreement 0.994792 and best-action agreement 0.980469.
gate_reasons: Three-action oracle gain LCB95 +0.142598 dB passes the +0.080 dB gate.
Three-over-nine oracle retention LCB95 0.995328 passes the 0.95 reduction-fidelity gate.
Both active actions exceed the frozen minimum of 30 grouped severe events: positive-full 90 and negative-full 277.
Minimum active-action severe-label agreement 0.994792 and best-action agreement 0.980469 pass their 0.95 operator-consistency gates.
All structural, role-isolation and protected-data checks pass.
competing_explanation: The action bank is not the limiting factor, and rare-event scarcity or operator-label disagreement cannot explain a future selector failure. Each active action is individually hazardous, especially negative-full, so success still depends on learning image-specific relative utility and downside risk rather than an action prior.
limitations: A0 is an offline development oracle and risk-prevalence audit; it does not demonstrate inference-time learnability or policy safety.
The result applies to the frozen three-action reduction and does not characterize the other six A0 candidates as deployable choices.
Ground truth is used only for offline labels and gates, never as an authorized model input.
Confirmation, historical A1X-432 outcomes, canary and locked test were not accessed.
